facts.value: Normal fighter construction installs ftData_MotionStateList and boundary341; demo fighter construction replaces them with ftData_803C52A0 and boundary14 and installs a different per-kind continuation table/resources. Fighter_ChangeMotionState compares msid against the current per-Fighter boundary, selects the common list or the per-kind list at msid-boundary, consumes metadata and installs all five callbacks. Thus341 is not universal and identical numeric IDs can select different records in normal and demo modes.
facts.rationale: Include verified demo consumer and dynamic boundary.

facts.value: Data-only C unit defining non-const MotionState ftData_MotionStateList[ftCo_MS_Count] with341 positional initializers and MotionState ftData_803C52A0[14] with14 demo initializers. MotionState declares enum_t anim_id, enum_t x4_flags, a u32/bitfield metadata union and five HSD_GObjEvent pointers in Anim/Input/Phys/Coll/Cam order. HSD_GObjEvent is void(*)(HSD_GObj*). Source describes the records but does not independently prove exact compiled section bytes, padding or object order.
facts.rationale: Identify auxiliary domain and separate source shape from compiled section claims.

facts.value: Defines two fighter motion descriptor tables:341 normal common-state records and14 demo common-state records. Each binds an animation-resource ID, two metadata components and five callback slots. The unit defines no functions or transition graph; callers choose the current table domain and perform transitions.
facts.rationale: Replace generic auxiliary wording with verified demo ownership.

facts.value: Supplies normal fighter common motion profiles covering death/respawn, movement, attacks, defense, damage, item/ledge/size states and specialized victim-side capture interactions, plus a separate14-entry demo table. Common means table domain, not identical behavior for every fighter or exclusive absence of character-specific interactions. The source wires handlers; individual transition conditions and execution order reside in consumers and callback bodies.
facts.rationale: Bound universal wording and account for demo profiles.

facts.value: Tables contain no mutation code and no explicit destination-state edges. Motion entry installs even NULL callback slots from the selected record; NULL means no handler in that slot, not absence of all engine processing. Main capture-neck/foot and Mewtwo capture records have only camera callbacks; ReboundStop has only animation. All demo Input/Phys/Coll/Cam slots are NULL. Demo Anim slots0/2/5 point to ftCo_800BED84/ftCo_800BEF00/ftCo_800BEFD0, whose canonical bodies are empty; remaining demo Anim slots are NULL.
facts.rationale: Document sparse/no-op profiles and avoid rendered-name role inference.
